description_en: Lists projects under the tenant with pagination, supporting fuzzy search by name or prompt
description_zh: 分页列出租户下的项目（Project），支持按名称/提示词模糊搜索
name: DescribeProjects

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量。默认10，最大支持20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Do not specify this parameter or set it to an empty string for the first page. For subsequent pages, pass the nextToken value from the previous response without any modification. If the nextToken in the response is empty, the last page has been reached
parameters.help_zh: 分页Token，首页不传nextToken省略或为空字符串，翻页原样回传把上一次响应的nextToken值不做任何修改地传入下一次请求，响应中nextToken 为空，已到最后一页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Fuzzy matches projects by project name or prompt
parameters.help_zh: 可按项目名称、提示词模糊查询
parameters.name: query
